findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment:
The following food items were observed with damaged packaging on the dry goods shelf :
 - There were at least 3 boxes of cereal with broken packaging
- There was an unidentifiable aluminum can without proper labeling of the food item

The items were shown to the PIC and pulled from the shelves. Ensure that the packaging of all food items are in good
condition and not exposed to any contaminants.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the
FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

Observed no hanging thermometers in the back reach-in coolers (for curbside pick up orders). Discussed with PIC. Ensure all cold holding units have hanging thermometers. Digital external thermometers will not suffice. Provide for cold holding units. Keep extra thermometers on hand in case of lost/broken/stolen thermometers. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Observed walk-in cooler fans to be soiled with a layer of black dust. Discussed with PIC. Ensure back walk-in cooler fans are routinely cleaned of dust. Observed the bases of the reach-in coolers in the back (for curbside pick up orders) to have debris. Clean the bases routinely to keep clean. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
5-501.17: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

Observed both all gender bathrooms to lack a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Both bathrooms had open-lid garbages. Discussed with PIC. Ensure trash cans have lids. Correct by next routine inspection.
